use_lvmlockd.description: Enable the lvmlockd daemon. Set to true if using shared storage or cluster-aware LVM operations.

pidfile.description: Path to the PID file for lvmlockd.

locking_type.description: Locking mechanism to use: 'none' (single host), 'disk' (file-based locking), or 'sanlock' (cluster-aware).

lockspace_dir.description: Directory used to hold lock space metadata files when using 'disk' locking mode.

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads to process lock requests. Increase under high lock contention.

lock_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a lock before timing out. Adjust based on storage latency.

max_lock_resources.description: Maximum number of lock resources the daemon will track. Increase for environments with many shared volumes.

auto_recover.description: If enabled, lvmlockd will attempt to automatically recover lock state on restart (e.g., after crash or reboot).

sanlock_resources.description: List of SANLOCK resources for cluster-aware distributed locking (requires sanlock package).

name.description: Unique name of the SANLOCK resource (must be consistent across cluster nodes).

path.description: Block device or file path used to store SANLOCK resource metadata.

offset.description: Byte offset within the resource path where the SANLOCK metadata starts (must be unique per resource).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=error, 1=warning, 2=info, 3=debug. Higher values produce more verbose logs.
